intended_use: generic acoustic-parameter checklist for bounding-box annotation

source_metadata.title: A continental-scale tool for acoustic identification of European bats
source_metadata.scope_note: European bat acoustic identification; not an Ozimops petersi source

generic_dimensions.name: onset
generic_dimensions.instruction: Place the start of the box where a coherent time-frequency ridge begins.

generic_dimensions.name: offset
generic_dimensions.instruction: Place the end of the box where the coherent ridge disappears.

generic_dimensions.name: duration
generic_dimensions.instruction: Use duration as a consistency check for visible call span, but do not force any expected duration.

generic_dimensions.name: low-frequency bound
generic_dimensions.instruction: Set the lower frequency bound to the lowest visible extent of the coherent call ridge, not to background noise.

generic_dimensions.name: high-frequency bound
generic_dimensions.instruction: Set the upper frequency bound to the highest visible extent of the coherent call ridge, avoiding isolated noise pixels.

generic_dimensions.name: bandwidth
generic_dimensions.instruction: Use bandwidth as a sanity check for whether the frequency extent captures the signal without excessive empty space.

generic_dimensions.name: centre or peak frequency
generic_dimensions.instruction: Use the strongest or most characteristic energy region to check whether the box is centred on the call rather than noise.

generic_dimensions.name: frequency-time ridge shape
generic_dimensions.instruction: Inspect whether the call ridge is steep, shallow, curved, quasi-constant-frequency or frequency-modulated.

generic_dimensions.name: signal quality and artefact rejection
generic_dimensions.instruction: Avoid including background noise, echo, overloaded regions, isolated artefacts or unrelated spectrogram energy.

warnings: This is generic acoustic-parameter guidance, not an Ozimops petersi prior.
It provides no expected OP duration, frequency range, bandwidth or shape.
It provides no European species-specific numeric ranges.
The spectrogram is the primary evidence.
BatDetect2 proposals are candidate regions, not ground truth.
Visible evidence should override this checklist.
Do not force every event to match any expected duration, bandwidth or shape.
Do not transfer European bat numeric values to Ozimops petersi.
